label: Finite root audits imply rooted closed esse collections
description: On the same q3a4 profile, the actual relation agrees with every audit of itself. The particular audited r is therefore an actual supplierless ancestor of the same x. Each actual cause edge retains both actuality guards and its supplier-to-recipient direction in esseCauseGraph p. A closed collection containing x must contain r by the finite path. This gives an alternative structural formulation of the existing rootedness premise and makes the data for a local positive certificate explicit; applicability of that premise remains open.
